facts.fact: StackAdapt's infrastructure engineer David Krutsko said he had worked at StackAdapt for over six years at the time of the post.
facts.quote: I’ve had the pleasure of working at StackAdapt for over six years!

facts.fact: David Krutsko said he has worked on three major projects that helped shape StackAdapt, which started because the company allowed engineers to take risks.
facts.quote: I’ve gotten to work on three major projects which helped shape the company, projects which started because we were allowed to take risks that ended up paying off.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog post on infrastructure engineering was published on January 6, 2022.
